title: Prove Multimedia Multipliziert with a rights-cleared, accessible, provenance-linked specimen
desired_change: Produce one complete media family from a canonical object with source receipt, claim-fidelity matrix, rights ledger, accessibility package, medium-native evals, C2PA use or documented non-applicability, release/withdrawal receipts, and maintenance owner.
expected_outcome: The capability is demonstrated as operational machinery rather than a well-written doctrine that depends on Bryan choosing what counts as sufficiently native or distinctive.

risk.rights_or_safety_impact: Media can misstate claims, violate rights, exclude users, or imply provenance that does not exist.

hidden_context_dependencies: Medium-native value and emotional precision are not calibrated with fixtures.
Rights ownership, likeness/voice permission, accessibility verification, and C2PA toolchain are unspecified.
No withdrawal or stale-version drill exists.
Strange Intact still depends on Bryan's unrecorded judgment.
acceptance_checks: A stranger can locate canon, identify transformations, verify rights, use accessible alternatives, and withdraw the derivative.
Claims added or omitted are explicit.
C2PA is treated as provenance evidence, not truth certification.
The specimen does not impersonate Bryan.
